values.source_term: Resolution No.313 adopted by city governing body
values.wording: Shall the following be adopted? An Ordinance of the City of Americus, Kansas prohibiting the installation and operation of High Impact Data Centers and Tier 2 and Tier 3 battery energy storage systems to protect the health, safety, and welfare of the residents of Americus, Kansas.
values.scope: Notice supports mixed-sector question; full ordinance thresholds, duration, qualification and legal force remain unverified
